name: Project agency
description: Nuxiva works on projects like an agency: the Director designs the solution and the team, the Critic questions itself and checks every result, agents run in parallel on the nuxiva-agency Rust engine.
capabilities: Task graph plan with roles, dependencies and acceptance criteria
Critic questions and answers saved and browsable
Every task reviewed only on the evidence delivered
Parallel agents sized to the hardware and the model chosen in Brain
Project files in the «09 Progetti» shared folder

files.question: Question
files.review_unclear: The review was inconclusive: redo the task meeting every acceptance criterion.

errors.unavailable: The project engine is not reachable
errors.empty_plan: The Director did not produce a usable plan
errors.goal: Describe the project in at least 8 characters
